description: This file provides functions and types for managing execution approval requests within a system, including registration, waiting for decisions, and building approval parameters, specifically in the context of host execution approval workflows.

classes.name: ExecApprovalRegistration
classes.description: Represents a registration record for an execution approval request, including ID, expiration time, and optional final decision.

classes.name: ParsedDecision
classes.description: Type returned by parseDecision indicating presence and value of a decision.

classes.name: RequestExecApprovalDecisionParams
classes.description: Parameters used to request an execution approval decision, including command details, environment, and context.

classes.name: ExecApprovalRequestToolParams
classes.description: Extended parameters for the approval request with timeout and two-phase flag.

classes.name: HostExecApprovalParams
classes.description: Parameters specific to host-based execution approval requests.

classes.name: ExecApprovalRequesterContext
classes.description: Context data for requestors like agent ID and session key.

classes.name: ExecApprovalTurnSourceContext
classes.description: Context information related to the source of the approval request, such as channels or threads.

methods.name: function buildExecApprovalRequestToolParams( buildExecApprovalRequestToolParams
methods.description: Constructs parameters for the approval request tool, merging core request data with defaults.

methods.name: function parseDecision(value: unknown): ParsedDecision { parseDecision
methods.description: Parses a response to determine if a decision is present and extract its string value.

methods.name: function parseString(value: unknown): string | undefined { parseString
methods.description: Utility function to safely parse a string value.

methods.name: function parseExpiresAtMs(value: unknown): number | undefined { parseExpiresAtMs
methods.description: Utility function to parse an expiration timestamp.

methods.name: export async function registerExecApprovalRequest( registerExecApprovalRequest
methods.description: Registers an approval request with the system and returns registration info.

methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a decision on an approval request.

methods.name: export async function resolveRegisteredExecApprovalDecision(params: { resolveRegisteredExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Resolves an approval decision, either pre-resolved or by waiting.

methods.name: export async function requestExecApprovalDecision( requestExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Requests an execution approval decision, handling registration and waiting as needed.

methods.name: export function buildExecApprovalRequesterContext(params: ExecApprovalRequesterContext): { buildExecApprovalRequesterContext
methods.description: Builds context data for requestors, such as agent ID and session key.

methods.name: export function buildExecApprovalTurnSourceContext( buildExecApprovalTurnSourceContext
methods.description: Builds context data about the source of the approval request.

methods.name: function buildHostApprovalDecisionParams( buildHostApprovalDecisionParams
